faults.name: no_forwarding
faults.why: back-to-back samples in one bin lose a count

faults.name: bin_from_low_bits
faults.why: the bin index uses the low bits of the code

faults.name: min_wrong_way
faults.why: the minimum is tracked the wrong way

faults.name: bram_copy_not_written
faults.why: the host's copy of the bins is never updated (bram variant, brief 63A)

faults.name: sine_wrong_slice
faults.why: the table address skips the top phase bit, so the sine runs at twice the frequency (bram variant)

faults.name: lut_sine_wrong_slice
faults.why: the same fault in the lut variant's table address (brief 63A)

faults.name: bram_next_entry
faults.why: the registered table read is one entry ahead of the phase (bram variant)

faults.name: triangle_no_fold
faults.why: the triangle is a saw at twice the rate

faults.name: shift_logical
faults.why: amplitude scaling shifts zeros into negative samples

faults.name: compare_unfinalised
faults.why: the compare uses the CRC before the final inversion, so every good frame is flagged

faults.name: wrong_polynomial
faults.why: one bit of the polynomial wrong

faults.name: sum_misses_first_pixel
faults.why: the first pixel of a frame is left out of the sum

faults.name: mismatch_not_counted
faults.why: a bad frame is never counted

faults.name: counts_both_edges
faults.why: falling edges counted too, so the frequency reads double

faults.name: duty_counts_low
faults.why: the duty counter counts the low clocks

faults.name: gate_half_length
faults.why: the gate is half as long as declared, so the duty and frequency scale are wrong

faults.name: pretrigger_off_by_one
faults.why: capture sample 0 is one sample late

faults.name: edge_mode_both_edges
faults.why: edge mode also triggers on falling edges

faults.name: post_trigger_short
faults.why: capture ends one sample early, so the last sample is stale
